title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.30 - The Blocked meter now counts what you do to the enemy, not only the block you stand behind. Damage an enemy never dealt because you made it Weak or took its Strength away (Piercing Wail, Enfeebling Touch, Malaise, Shackling Potion, ...) is credited to you under the card or potion that did it, so Malaise's Weak and Strength loss read as one row. Debuffs act before block, so a hit they shrank spends less block, and the block they saved is overblock like any other. It works the other way too: Strength you give an enemy (Fight Me!, Philosopher's Stone, Brimstone) makes its hits land harder, and that extra damage is booked against you as a negative row - an outline in your colour with the number in red. A teammate's Fight Me! shows on your breakdown, but the cost is theirs. Verified in game on v0.111.0 and v0.107.1.
